diagnoses.description:
The agent wrote formulas using function names that LibreOffice in this environment did not recognize (notably NORM.S.INV and STDEV.S), causing widespread #NAME? evaluation failures until patched.
Evidence: LibreOffice recalculation returned 863 #NAME? errors affecting Answer (e.g., Answer!C3, C4, C5, C6, C13, etc.) and Gold price volatility formulas (Turn 21).
Trajectory location: turn 20-21

Incomplete data discovery risk: by not programmatically scanning the entire row/columns for all non-null 2025 entries across the full width of the Value/Volume sheets, the solution may omit additional eligible countries that exist beyond the initially inspected columns, which would make Step 2/3 incomplete relative to the instruction “Find all the countries that has 2025 gold reserves value data”.
Evidence: The rolling summary states Value/Volume sheets were inspected only for the “first 9 columns” and found a limited set of 2025 non-empty countries (e.g., Value 2025: Belarus, Georgia; Volume 2025: Uzbekistan, Czechia, Slovakia, Latvia). In Turn 20, the agent hard-coded Step 2 countries to exactly ['Belarus','Georgia','Uzbekistan','Czechia','Slovakia','Latvia'] and mapped them to specific fixed columns (Value!D18, Value!F18, Volume!F18..I18) rather than scanning all columns for any other 2025 entries.
Trajectory location: turn 12-13 and turn 20

This fixes an error-state but may remove an intended template formula/value in that cell; the trace does not show validation that Volume!E15 was safe to blank without affecting required outputs.
Evidence: The agent cleared Volume!E15 (first conditionally if it equaled '#N/A', later unconditionally) to eliminate a recalculation error (Turns 23 and 26).
Trajectory location: turn 23 and turn 26
